28NUM_SIPS = 24 

29_INT32_MAX = torch.iinfo(torch.int32).max 

30_FAST_DTYPES = (torch.bool, torch.uint8, torch.int8, torch.int16, torch.int32)

35# GCU400 override of the generic pointwise_dynamic implementation. 

36# 

37# The generic path is a block-pointer kernel (grid capped at 48, i1 loads for 

38# bool, and -- for the scalar variants -- the Python scalar wrapped into a 0-dim 

39# device tensor whose stride-0 broadcast is materialized per tile). Measured on 

40# the core bench shapes (L600) it costs bool 0.60-0.85x and mid-size shapes 

41# 0.82-0.93x vs torch native, and for the (bool tensor, int scalar) mix it even 

42# produces wrong values: torch promotes that mix to an int64 result, the 

43# generated kernel stores 8 bytes per element into the fake-int64 (4-byte-slot) 

44# output buffer, so readback is interleaved garbage. 

45# 

46# The flat grid-stride kernels below saturate the memory floor instead: 

47# * tensor pairs: 2-read/1-write flat stream, bool handled through an int8 

48# lane view (0/1 bytes AND identically, and the i1 lowering loses ~35% 

49# bandwidth); 

50# * scalar variants: the scalar rides as a kernel argument (no 0-dim tensor, 

51# no broadcast materialization); 

52# * (bool tensor, int scalar): torch promotes to int64; the int64 output is 

53# a fake container whose value channel is one 32-bit word per element, so 

54# the kernel bitcasts the output pointer to int32 and stores one word per 

55# element (kthvalue precedent). 

56# Everything exotic (broadcasting, strided inputs, mixed tensor dtypes, 

57# out-of-int32-range sizes, int64 tensors) falls back to the generic kernels. 

58@libentry() 

59@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["N_total"]) 

60def bitwise_and_flat_kernel( 

61 x_ptr, y_ptr, out_ptr, N_total, BLOCK: tl.constexpr, HAS_TAIL: tl.constexpr 

62): 

63 # 2026-11-16 round-2 restore: HAS_TAIL dual arm. The FULL arm drops the 

64 # per-element predicate and must pair with num_stages=1 (FULL+ns2 measured 

65 # +12% on int32 mid); the MASK arm keeps the pipelined production ns=2. 

66 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

67 num_pids = tl.num_programs(0) 

68 arange = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

69 num_blocks = (N_total + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK 

70 if HAS_TAIL: 

71 for block_id in tl.range(pid, num_blocks, num_pids, num_stages=2): 

72 off = block_id * BLOCK + arange 

73 mask = off < N_total 

74 x = tl.load(x_ptr + off, mask=mask) 

75 y = tl.load(y_ptr + off, mask=mask) 

76 tl.store(out_ptr + off, x & y, mask=mask) 

77 else: 

78 for block_id in tl.range(pid, num_blocks, num_pids, num_stages=1): 

79 off = block_id * BLOCK + arange 

80 x = tl.load(x_ptr + off) 

81 y = tl.load(y_ptr + off) 

82 tl.store(out_ptr + off, x & y) 

83

87def bitwise_and_scalar_flat_kernel(x_ptr, out_ptr, y, N_total, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):

99@libentry() 

100@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["N_total", "y"]) 

101def bitwise_and_bool_int_flat_kernel( 

102 x_ptr, out_ptr, y, N_total, BLOCK: tl.constexpr, HAS_TAIL: tl.constexpr 

103): 

104 # (bool tensor, int scalar) promotes to int64 and the result buffer holds one 

105 # 8-byte element per input, so write int64 directly (bitcasting to int32 here 

106 # would leave the high word of every element untouched -> garbage readback). 

107 out64 = out_ptr.to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int64)) 

108 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

109 num_pids = tl.num_programs(0) 

110 arange = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

111 num_blocks = (N_total + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK 

112 for block_id in tl.range(pid, num_blocks, num_pids, num_stages=2): 

113 off = block_id * BLOCK + arange 

114 if HAS_TAIL: 

115 mask = off < N_total 

116 x = tl.load(x_ptr + off, mask=mask) 

117 v = (x & y.to(x_ptr.dtype.element_ty)).to(tl.int64) 

118 tl.store(out64 + off, v, mask=mask) 

119 else: 

120 x = tl.load(x_ptr + off) 

121 v = (x & y.to(x_ptr.dtype.element_ty)).to(tl.int64) 

122 tl.store(out64 + off, v)

125# 2026-11-16 round-3 (bitwise_xor wide-lane precedent): 1-byte lanes widened 4x 

126# into int32 words. AND is lane-width agnostic (bitwise, no carries), so four 

127# adjacent bool/int8/uint8 elements ride one int32 lane. In the 2^24..2^28 

128# element band (tensor) / 2^20..2^28 (scalar) the byte-lane stream is 

129# element-rate bound; the widened word stream measured -3~-5% (tensor) and 

130# -14.6% (scalar 1R1W @2^24) on the xor twin. Outside the band both widths hit 

131# the same DRAM floor, so the widened path is dispatched only inside the band. 

132# n must be word-divisible (n & 3 == 0) and 4-byte aligned, else per-element. 

133@libentry() 

134@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["N_lanes"]) 

135def bitwise_and_wide_kernel( 

136 x_ptr, y_ptr, out_ptr, N_lanes, BLOCK: tl.constexpr, HAS_TAIL: tl.constexpr 

137): 

138 x32 = x_ptr.to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int32)) 

139 y32 = y_ptr.to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int32)) 

140 o32 = out_ptr.to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int32)) 

141 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

142 num_pids = tl.num_programs(0) 

143 arange = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

144 num_blocks = (N_lanes + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK 

145 if HAS_TAIL: 

146 for block_id in tl.range(pid, num_blocks, num_pids, num_stages=2): 

147 off = block_id * BLOCK + arange 

148 mask = off < N_lanes 

149 x = tl.load(x32 + off, mask=mask) 

150 y = tl.load(y32 + off, mask=mask) 

151 tl.store(o32 + off, x & y, mask=mask) 

152 else: 

153 for block_id in tl.range(pid, num_blocks, num_pids, num_stages=1): 

154 off = block_id * BLOCK + arange 

155 x = tl.load(x32 + off) 

156 y = tl.load(y32 + off) 

157 tl.store(o32 + off, x & y)

196def _choose_block(n_total, itemsize): 

197 # do_bench(median, warmup=1000ms/rep=100ms) sweep on GCU400 (L600): 

198 # num_warps=2 beats 4 on every bucket; tiny shapes want the exact pow2 

199 # tile, mid shapes peak at 65536 lanes, and only >2^28-element 1/2-byte 

200 # streams gain from 131072 (num_stages and a 2-block unroll both lose). 

201 if n_total <= 8192: 

202 return max(triton.next_power_of_2(n_total), 2) 

203 if n_total <= 65536: 

204 return 8192 

205 if n_total <= 524288: 

206 return 32768 

207 if n_total > (1 << 28) and itemsize <= 2: 

208 return 131072 

209 return 65536 

210 

211 

212def _lane_view(t): 

213 # Bool tensors ride the int8 lane: 0/1 bytes AND identically and the 

214 # generic i1 lowering is ~35% off the byte-stream memory floor. 

215 return t.view(torch.int8) if t.dtype == torch.bool else t 

216 

217 

218def _packed_lane_view(t): 

219 # Two adjacent 2-byte lanes ride one 32-bit lane. Bitwise AND does not care 

220 # which half a bit lives in, and the packed scalar mask is duplicated into 

221 # both halves, so the result is endian-independent. 

222 return t.reshape(-1).view(torch.int32) 

223 

224 

225def _packed_scalar_value(dtype, scalar): 

226 value = _scalar_lane_value(dtype, scalar) & 0xFFFF 

227 packed = value | (value << 16) 

228 return packed - (1 << 32) if packed >= (1 << 31) else packed 

229 

230 

231def _launch_flat(kern, grid, args, block, num_warps=8, **constexprs): 

232 # The external llvm converter intermittently fails on cold compiles 

233 # (nondeterministic host-level flake on shared nodes); retrying the 

234 # launch recompiles and succeeds (rad2deg / atan2_ / sinh precedents). 

235 for attempt in range(3): 

236 try: 

237 with torch_device_fn.device(args[0].device): 

238 kern[grid](*args, num_warps=num_warps, BLOCK=block, **constexprs) 

239 return 

240 except Exception as exc: 

241 if attempt == 2: 

242 raise 

243 logger.warning( 

244 "bitwise_and flat kernel launch failed (attempt %d): %s", 

245 attempt + 1, 

246 exc, 

247 ) 

248

250def _fast_tensor(t): 

251 return ( 

252 isinstance(t, torch.Tensor) 

253 and t.is_cuda 

254 and t.is_contiguous() 

255 and t.dtype in _FAST_DTYPES 

256 and t.numel() <= _INT32_MAX 

257 )

260def _flat_config(n_total, itemsize): 

261 # Scalar / mixed-path ladder (unchanged by the tensor round-2 binning). 

262 block = _choose_block(n_total, itemsize) 

263 if triton.cdiv(n_total, block) * block > _INT32_MAX: 

264 return None 

265 # GCU400 (L600) sweep: 2-byte lanes already saturate the memory floor with one 

266 # CTA per SIP, and doubling the CTA count only adds a tail wave (16.7M int16: 

267 # 29.1us -> 27.3us). 1-byte and 4-byte lanes still need two CTA waves to 

268 # hide the tail, so keep NUM_SIPS * 2 there. 

269 grid_cap = NUM_SIPS if itemsize == 2 else NUM_SIPS * 2 

270 return block, (min(triton.cdiv(n_total, block), grid_cap),) 

271 

272 

273def _tensor_flat_config(n_total, itemsize): 

274 # 2026-11-16 round-2 restore: tensor paths bin by cdiv>=1024 x itemsize. 

275 # * 1B lanes: FULL (mask-free) arm + nw2 + g48 at every size (bool 1Gi 

276 # probe -6%; nw8 under FULL costs +14% on bool mid); 

277 # * 2B/4B mid-small (cdiv<1024): FULL + nw2 (2B g48 / 4B g24) -- int16 

278 # mid -6.1%, int32 mid -2.6% vs the masked arm; 

279 # * 2B/4B large (cdiv>=1024, long grid-stride loops): the masked + 

280 # pipelined (ns=2) arm wins -- mask-free costs +1.8% there -- so keep 

281 # the production MASK+nw8+g24 config (int16 1Gi bitwise unchanged). 

282 # FULL must pair with ns=1; non-divisible sizes fall back to the MASK arm 

283 # via HAS_TAIL. 

284 block = _choose_block(n_total, itemsize) 

285 if triton.cdiv(n_total, block) * block > _INT32_MAX: 

286 return None 

287 cdiv = triton.cdiv(n_total, block) 

288 has_tail = (n_total % block) != 0 

289 if itemsize == 1: 

290 return block, (min(cdiv, NUM_SIPS * 2),), 2, has_tail 

291 if cdiv < 1024: 

292 grid_cap = NUM_SIPS * 2 if itemsize == 2 else NUM_SIPS 

293 return block, (min(cdiv, grid_cap),), 2, has_tail 

294 return block, (min(cdiv, NUM_SIPS),), 8, True 

295 

296 

297# 2026-11-16 round-3 widened-lane band (bitwise_xor probe crossover): the int32 

298# word stream beats the byte-lane stream only inside these bands; outside both 

299# hit the same DRAM floor and the per-element ladder stays. 

300_WIDE_MAX = 1 << 28 

301_WIDE_TENSOR_MIN = 1 << 24 

302_WIDE_SCALAR_MIN = 1 << 20 

303_WIDE_TENSOR_CONFIG = (32768, 2) 

304 

305 

306def _tensor_wide_config(A, B, out): 

307 n_total = A.numel() 

308 if ( 

309 A.element_size() != 1 

310 or not (_WIDE_TENSOR_MIN <= n_total <= _WIDE_MAX) 

311 or n_total & 3 

312 or A.data_ptr() & 3 

313 or B.data_ptr() & 3 

314 or out.data_ptr() & 3 

315 ): 

316 return None 

317 block, num_warps = _WIDE_TENSOR_CONFIG 

318 n_lanes = n_total >> 2 

319 has_tail = (n_lanes % block) != 0 

320 return ( 

321 block, 

322 (min(triton.cdiv(n_lanes, block), NUM_SIPS * 2),), 

323 num_warps, 

324 n_lanes, 

325 has_tail, 

326 ) 

327 

328 

329def _scalar_wide_config(tensor, out): 

330 n_total = tensor.numel() 

331 if ( 

332 tensor.element_size() != 1 

333 or not (_WIDE_SCALAR_MIN <= n_total <= _WIDE_MAX) 

334 or n_total & 3 

335 or tensor.data_ptr() & 3 

336 or out.data_ptr() & 3 

337 ): 

338 return None 

339 n_lanes = n_total >> 2 

340 # AND-specific sweep (interleaved A/B, 2^24..2^27): 32768/nw2 beats the 

341 # xor-twin 8192/nw4 ladder by +12~21% everywhere in-band (nw4 ties nw2; 

342 # 16384 and 65536 tiles lose). Sibling configs do not transfer verbatim. 

343 block, num_warps = 32768, 2 

344 has_tail = (n_lanes % block) != 0 

345 return ( 

346 block, 

347 (min(triton.cdiv(n_lanes, block), NUM_SIPS * 2),), 

348 num_warps, 

349 n_lanes, 

350 has_tail, 

351 ) 

352 

353 

354def _wide_scalar_word(dtype, scalar): 

355 # Replicate the wrapped lane byte 4x into one int32 word: AND-ing the word 

356 # ANDs each byte lane with the scalar byte, byte-for-byte identical to the 

357 # per-element path (bitwise_xor wide precedent). 

358 v = _scalar_lane_value(dtype, scalar) & 0xFF 

359 word = v | (v << 8) | (v << 16) | (v << 24) 

360 return word - (1 << 32) if word >= (1 << 31) else word 

361 

362 

363def _scalar_lane_value(dtype, scalar): 

364 # AND only ever looks at the scalar's low bits, so wrap it into the lane 

365 # dtype's range on the host (two's complement for signed lanes). 

366 if dtype == torch.bool: 

367 return 1 if scalar else 0 

368 bits = torch.iinfo(dtype).bits 

369 value = int(scalar) & ((1 << bits) - 1) 

370 if value >= (1 << (bits - 1)) and dtype.is_signed: 

371 value -= 1 << bits 

372 return value 

373 

374 

375def _is_python_scalar(v): 

376 return isinstance(v, bool) or isinstance(v, int) 

377 

378 

379def _and_scalar_impl(tensor, scalar, out=None): 

380 # Shared by bitwise_and_scalar / bitwise_and_scalar_tensor (AND commutes) 

381 # and by the in-place variant (out=tensor). Returns None when the input 

382 # pair is not eligible for the flat path. 

383 if not _fast_tensor(tensor) or not _is_python_scalar(scalar): 

384 return None 

385 mixed = not isinstance(scalar, bool) and tensor.dtype == torch.bool 

386 out_dtype = torch.int64 if mixed else tensor.dtype 

387 if out is None: 

388 out = torch.empty_like(tensor, dtype=out_dtype) 

389 elif out.dtype != out_dtype: 

390 return None 

391 n_total = tensor.numel() 

392 if n_total == 0: 

393 return out 

394 if mixed: 

395 config = _flat_config(n_total, tensor.element_size()) 

396 if config is None: 

397 return None 

398 block, grid = config 

399 # (bool, int) promotes to int64; the scalar only contributes its low bit 

400 # because every input value is 0 or 1. 

401 _launch_flat( 

402 bitwise_and_bool_int_flat_kernel, 

403 grid, 

404 (_lane_view(tensor), out, int(scalar) & 1, n_total), 

405 block, 

406 HAS_TAIL=(n_total % block) != 0, 

407 ) 

408 return out 

409 

410 n_lanes = n_total 

411 x_lanes = _lane_view(tensor) 

412 out_lanes = _lane_view(out) 

413 lane_itemsize = tensor.element_size() 

414 y_value = _scalar_lane_value(tensor.dtype, scalar) 

415 if lane_itemsize == 1: 

416 # 1-byte lanes pack 4x into int32 words inside the measured band 

417 # (bitwise_xor wide precedent: scalar 1R1W @2^24 -14.6%). 

418 wide = _scalar_wide_config(tensor, out) 

419 if wide is not None: 

420 block, grid, num_warps, n_lanes_w, has_tail = wide 

421 _launch_flat( 

422 bitwise_and_scalar_wide_kernel, 

423 grid, 

424 ( 

425 x_lanes, 

426 out_lanes, 

427 _wide_scalar_word(tensor.dtype, scalar), 

428 n_lanes_w, 

429 ), 

430 block, 

431 num_warps, 

432 HAS_TAIL=has_tail, 

433 ) 

434 return out 

435 if ( 

436 tensor.dtype in _PACKED_PAIR_DTYPES 

437 and n_total % 2 == 0 

438 and tensor.data_ptr() % 4 == 0 

439 and out.data_ptr() % 4 == 0 

440 ): 

441 # 2-byte lanes pack into 4-byte ones: same bytes, half the trip count. 

442 # Mid-size int16 streams measure ~3% faster (16.7M: 28.2us -> 27.3us) 

443 # while large ones stay at the memory floor. 

444 x_lanes = _packed_lane_view(x_lanes) 

445 out_lanes = _packed_lane_view(out_lanes) 

446 y_value = _packed_scalar_value(tensor.dtype, scalar) 

447 n_lanes = n_total // 2 

448 lane_itemsize = 4 

449 config = _flat_config(n_lanes, lane_itemsize) 

450 if config is None: 

451 return None 

452 block, grid = config 

453 _launch_flat( 

454 bitwise_and_scalar_flat_kernel, 

455 grid, 

456 (x_lanes, out_lanes, y_value, n_lanes), 

457 block, 

458 ) 

459 return out

462def bitwise_and_tensor(A, B): 

463 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME BITWISE_AND") 

464 if ( 

465 _fast_tensor(A) 

466 and _fast_tensor(B) 

467 and A.dtype == B.dtype 

468 and A.shape == B.shape 

469 and A.device == B.device 

470 ): 

471 out = torch.empty_like(A) 

472 n_total = out.numel() 

473 if n_total == 0: 

474 return out 

475 wide = _tensor_wide_config(A, B, out) 

476 if wide is not None: 

477 block, grid, num_warps, n_lanes, has_tail = wide 

478 _launch_flat( 

479 bitwise_and_wide_kernel, 

480 grid, 

481 (_lane_view(A), _lane_view(B), _lane_view(out), n_lanes), 

482 block, 

483 num_warps, 

484 HAS_TAIL=has_tail, 

485 ) 

486 return out 

487 config = _tensor_flat_config(n_total, A.element_size()) 

488 if config is not None: 

489 block, grid, num_warps, has_tail = config 

490 _launch_flat( 

491 bitwise_and_flat_kernel, 

492 grid, 

493 (_lane_view(A), _lane_view(B), _lane_view(out), n_total), 

494 block, 

495 num_warps, 

496 HAS_TAIL=has_tail, 

497 ) 

498 return out 

499 return bitwise_and_func(A, B)

502def bitwise_and_tensor_(A, B): 

503 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME BITWISE_AND_") 

504 if ( 

505 _fast_tensor(A) 

506 and _fast_tensor(B) 

507 and A.dtype == B.dtype 

508 and A.shape == B.shape 

509 and A.device == B.device 

510 and (A is B or A.untyped_storage().data_ptr() != B.untyped_storage().data_ptr()) 

511 ): 

512 n_total = A.numel() 

513 if n_total == 0: 

514 return A 

515 wide = _tensor_wide_config(A, B, A) 

516 if wide is not None: 

517 block, grid, num_warps, n_lanes, has_tail = wide 

518 _launch_flat( 

519 bitwise_and_wide_kernel, 

520 grid, 

521 (_lane_view(A), _lane_view(B), _lane_view(A), n_lanes), 

522 block, 

523 num_warps, 

524 HAS_TAIL=has_tail, 

525 ) 

526 return A 

527 config = _tensor_flat_config(n_total, A.element_size()) 

528 if config is not None: 

529 block, grid, num_warps, has_tail = config 

530 _launch_flat( 

531 bitwise_and_flat_kernel, 

532 grid, 

533 (_lane_view(A), _lane_view(B), _lane_view(A), n_total), 

534 block, 

535 num_warps, 

536 HAS_TAIL=has_tail, 

537 ) 

538 return A 

539 return bitwise_and_func(A, B, out0=A)

542def bitwise_and_scalar(A, B): 

543 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME BITWISE_AND_SCALAR") 

544 out = _and_scalar_impl(A, B) 

545 if out is not None:

550def bitwise_and_scalar_(A, B): 

551 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME BITWISE_AND_SCALAR_") 

552 if isinstance(A, torch.Tensor) and _is_python_scalar(B): 

553 if A.dtype == torch.bool and not isinstance(B, bool): 

554 # torch raises for the (bool, int) in-place promotion; the generic 

555 # pointwise path silently truncates instead, so keep aten parity 

556 # (bitwise_xor precedent). 

557 raise RuntimeError( 

558 "result type Long can't be cast to the desired output type Bool" 

559 ) 

560 out = _and_scalar_impl(A, B, out=A) 

561 if out is not None: 

562 return A 

563 return bitwise_and_func_scalar(A, B, out0=A)

566def bitwise_and_scalar_tensor(A, B): 

567 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME BITWISE_AND_SCALAR_TENSOR") 

568 # AND commutes, so (scalar, tensor) reuses the (tensor, scalar) path. 

569 if _is_python_scalar(A): 

570 out = _and_scalar_impl(B, A) 

571 if out is not None: 

572 return out 

573 return bitwise_and_func_scalar(B, A)
